Non-compliance doesn't fundamentally change anything. 

No one's asking the real question: why the fuck have we allowed ourselves to get into a situation where the question of compliance is the least bit relevant in the first place?

There is no non-psychotic answer to that question other than, "Because, psychosis."

Does non-compliance faze psychopaths?

No.

No.

So what the fuck are you talking about?

As if taking orders from people who are not liars, thieves, pedophiles, rapists, and mass murderers would be okay?

The problem isn't with those mutherfuckers.

The problem is with the codependence that got us all into this FUBAR in the first place.

Until you deal with your own obsession with obedience and demand for those to obey, comply or not, you're fucked. And you'll stay fucked until you do.

“But we need leaders, don’t we?”

Do you need rapists?

Your “leaders” are who mindfucked compliance into you in the first place.

comment.body:
I just can't understand why everybody glibly accepts this story about Jews being indigenous to the Levant.

If you go by the story in the Torah, the people who descended from Israel and his sons were actually indigenous to Egypt. They invaded, attacked, committed genocide, and hijacked the so-called promised Land, claiming to own it after decimating and displacing the people who lived there.

By what stretch of imagination or reason did that make them indigenous?

They were invaders, pirates, and genocidists without any right to the land. None at all. The only semblance of the "right" they claimed was self-bestowed according to their own story of their genocidal God that promised them they could steal it from the current residents.

How does that give the large percentage European people now in Palestine any right to the land at all? They did it once before so that gives them a right to do it again?

It doesn't make a shred of sense, and yet everybody swallows it. I don't know how they avoid choking.

comment.body:
I can't get over how in our faces this is and no one says anything about it.

Recognize that the ONLY claim that the "children of Israel" have to ANY territory at all in Palestine is the FACT, recorded in their own literature, that they invaded, attacked, slaughtered, pillaged, raped, and decimated their way across an already inhabited land because of a divine hallucination that "promised" it to them, pretending their genocide was justice.

This is the ONLY argument Shizzraelis can make:

"We did it once, so we have the divine right to do it all over again."

It doesn't matter how they rationalize it: the fact is that Shizzrael is what it is because it's done what it did BECAUSE THAT IS WHAT THE VAST MAJORITY OF JEWS AROUND THE WORLD WANTED IT TO DO AND INTENDED THAT IT DO, FOR AT LEAST 150 YEARS SINCE THE ADVENT OF "ZIONISM": ABSOFUCKINGLOOTELY JUST WHAT IT'S DONE.

"But we never wanted GENOCIDE! We NEVER intended to commit crimes against humanity!"

Kinda like steering your car and flooring the pedal but you "didn't mean to" run that guy over in the street? You had no idea that's what would happen, right? You're not a murderer, right? It just turned out that way, right?

Holy fucking shit. Actually, I can't do their smarmy bullshit nearly like they can.

One more fact: the surge in outcry "against" Zionism from Jews globally -- especially this chestnut about Judaism isn't Zionism -- began in the summer of 2025.

Seems the penny finally dropped. 

I see nothing but saving their own hides in the protestations that have surged since then.

And notice: VERY few now distancing themselves from Zionism actually say much at all about it -- only that it's not to be equated with Judaism. 

That's quite telling.

Where has the outcry been from Jews around the world since the "First Aliyah" when the invasion of Palestine began?

What percentage of Jews around the world have opposed Shizzraeli CRIMES AGAINST HUMANITY before they came to their senses that THE SHIT THEY'VE SUPPORTED, THE CRIMES AGAINST PALESTINIANS OVER FAR MORE THAN A CENTURY, IS ABSOLUTELY GOING TO BLOW BACK ONTO THEM?

They can argue that the tree of Judaism is not the tree of Zionism, but they're fucking LYING.

They know as well as you and I do that both grow from the same root:

"WE are God's chosen AND YOU ARE NOT."

Judaism is supremacism. Period. 

It's never been anything but.

And now, because Mom is afraid of what the neighbors will say, she's kicked her extremist son to the curb and pretends, "I never knew him."
